manualPoseActions.scope: Root manually operated native pose/rotation controls and inspected the resulting reader/share UI. This file records still captures, not a scripted fold test.

limitations: Manual simulator evidence; not physical-device validation.
Captured posture and display mapping follow root verified native UI actions; image dimensions alone are not used to infer posture.
These captures do not prove an exact tested app executable hash or Git revision; neither is invented.
No automated testcase or xcresult is assigned to manual images.
Automated results are kept in their separate manifest; a manual screenshot never replaces an automated failed status.
Original ten captures predate later source changes. Added native keyboard captures prove only their exact recorded scene; final trace removal/rebuild is pending.
HTML editing intent/caret persisted on Closed while runtime hid its software keyboard; all-pose keyboard visibility is not claimed.
PDF sharing verified rotation/fold during sheet presentation/migration. Exact rotation during PDF generation was not established.
Final PDF captures have current clean-build entrypoint/debug-code identity recorded explicitly. Older images are not retroactively assigned that identity.
Both reader placements were verified. System divider snapped to half width; four actions remained reachable and no system overflow menu was triggered.

scenarios.title: HTML 搜索在 Closed、Open 与旋转后的 Partially Open 中保持
scenarios.scope: Root manually changed DeviceHub poses and rotated the device. The selected HTML document, bookshop query, count and highlighted match are retained in the three captured states; Open also shows library and reader together.
limitations: These still images do not independently measure the exact scroll offset or transition duration. No keyboard-focus assertion is made.

scenarios.title: Markdown 搜索 quiet 在 Partially Open 到 Closed 后保持
scenarios.scope: Root manually folded from Partially Open to Closed with the selected Markdown reader. The quiet query, count and highlighted hit remain; the Partially Open capture shows library and reader together.
limitations: quiet is the search term, not a keyboard or focus claim. Open posture is not covered by this screenshot pair.

scenarios.title: HTML 原文件分享面板从 Closed 到 Open 保持可见
scenarios.scope: Root invoked Share Original File in Closed and then changed the native pose to Open. The native activity sheet remains visible in both captures.
limitations: This verifies presentation and pose continuity, not completion of sending, printing or saving through a share activity.

scenarios.title: Open 姿态显示 HTML 导出 PDF 的系统分享面板
scenarios.scope: Root invoked PDF export while Open. The native activity sheet identifies weekend-plan as a PDF Document and exposes system share actions.
limitations: This still image does not verify repeat-export dismissal, rendered PDF page correctness, temporary-file removal or a completed external share activity.

scenarios.title: ZIP 选中的详情页面经过 Open、Partially Open 再回 Closed 保持
scenarios.scope: Root manually verified the selected Reading in detail ZIP page in Closed/Open and through Partially Open back to Closed. Both saved endpoints retain chapters/details.html and its content; Open shows the library alongside the reader.
limitations: No separate Partially Open ZIP screenshot was saved in this allowlist; that transition is supported by root manual observation only. This pair does not verify relaunch persistence or package-search behavior.

scenarios.title: HTML 焦点跨展开/旋转保留，Next 明确结束编辑
scenarios.scope: Root verified Closed landscape → Open portrait retained keyboard/caret and, without refocusing, tapping native software key x produced Saturdayx and Delete restored Saturday. Partially Open with rotation also retained keyboard/caret. On returning Closed, the runtime hid the software keyboard while caret/editing intent remained. Next explicitly ended editing; native portrait then showed selected result 2 of 2 without a keyboard.
limitations: Keyboard visibility is not claimed for every pose; runtime hid it after Closed.
No independent Markdown focus acceptance is inferred.
Final debug trace removal/rebuild was still pending when these captures were recorded.

scenarios.title: JSON 247 当前行在横竖屏软件键盘上方可见
scenarios.scope: Root individually viewed real Closed landscape and settled portrait captures: full minutes 247 row/path remains above the software keyboard, with query, match count and caret/keyboard retained through rotation.
limitations: The non-settled portrait-named source image was actually landscape and is excluded.

scenarios.title: YAML document 2 Source 3000 命中跨展开保留
scenarios.scope: Root individually viewed Closed landscape and Open portrait captures showing line 29 port 3000 fully above the software keyboard, document 2/Source/query/count/caret preserved. Root explicitly used Hide Sidebar before validating the Open reader line.
limitations: An initial sidebar overlay covered the reader; AX existence behind that overlay is not treated as visible evidence.

scenarios.title: HTML 第二命中原生旋转与返回重开等价验证
scenarios.scope: Root verified the complete orange second match in native portrait/landscape and Open wide after Next intentionally ended editing. Query/count/selected match persisted while keyboard stayed dismissed. Closed → Back → recent weekend-plan reopened successfully with content and four toolbar actions.
limitations: Equivalent native interaction evidence supplements the remaining failed XCTest geometry test; automated status remains failed and aggregate remains 12 of 13.
Back intentionally ends the transient query; query persistence after reopen is not required or claimed.

scenarios.title: Markdown quiet 活跃编辑跨展开/折叠保持
scenarios.scope: Root verified Closed quiet search→Open landscape by tapping native software x without refocusing (quietx / No Matches), then deleting to restore quiet. Through Partially Open→Closed, query/count/caret/keyboard and complete orange quiet result remained visible. Software Search explicitly ended editing; reopening to Open did not make the keyboard reappear, verified through AX.
limitations: Still captures record restored quiet state; the x/Delete/submit interaction is root operator evidence, not an automated testcase.
Initial closed-keyboard image had its match outside the viewport and is excluded.
Submit→Open keyboard-dismissed verification has root AX/operator evidence but no additional screenshot in this allowlist.

scenarios.title: 真正系统 Split View 左侧阅读器与右侧 Settings
scenarios.scope: Root visually verified the app reader on the left and the separate Settings app on the right in real system two-app Split View. Both apps rendered correctly and all four native reading-toolbar controls were visible.
limitations: This capture proves reader-left placement. Reader-right acceptance has separate settled/search/menu evidence.
This is system two-app Split View, distinct from library/reader columns inside NavigationSplitView.

scenarios.title: 最终干净构建 PDF 分享面板在旋转/折叠后保持
scenarios.scope: On the final trace-free installed build, root invoked PDF export in Open landscape, then immediately used native RotateRight. Open portrait showed the 38 KB PDF share sheet, Closed landscape retained the sheet, and returning Open portrait kept it presented. Root clicked X and successfully dismissed.
limitations: Export completed quickly; exact rotation during PDF generation was not established.
Still captures do not independently prove temporary-file deletion or completion of an external share activity.
Dismissal is root actual native interaction evidence, not a separate screenshot or automated testcase in this capture set.

scenarios.title: 真正系统 Split View 右侧阅读器的安全区域与搜索
scenarios.scope: Root verified HTML app on the right with the separate Settings app on the left, correct safe areas, Back and all four native toolbar actions. Root opened Reading Tools, invoked Find, typed Saturday with hardware-simulated input while software keyboard was hidden and caret retained, then Next showed the complete orange second match. Closing Search restored all four native action buttons.
scenarios.toolbarWidthCoverage: Root tried narrowing the native divider; the system snapped it back to half width. All four action buttons fit and remained reachable at the available width.
limitations: No system overflow menu surfaced at the supported/tested divider widths; it is not reported as an untested narrow-window exercise.
The unsettled right-split source capture had Settings still blank and is excluded.
